lines.en: Oh, my God, that is your entire back.
Can you come zip me up?
isn't bringing up any real feelings for you, is it?
Did my kiss unlock some dark secret yearning
lying dormant at the bottom of your heart?
No. Of the eight times we've kissed,
You ready to act all lovey-dovey on my livestream?
Um, actually, can you-- my mom normally--
Okay. And then this goes through here.
I did not know I knew how to do this.
My Avril Lavigne phase really paid off.
I think you might want to get to the party.
Bones for dogs to chew on, but still not great.
Is this serious enough for you?
You really got the message across.
That my app is dead on arrival.
Before you judge, have you seen the soft cheeses?
Chic dress code, focus on you, boring as hell.
What sad event does this remind you of?
I gotta go see if I can salvage this.
Spencer, can you please just, I don't know, brighten the place up a bit?
I was told to brighten things up.
Can I have either of your phone numbers?
Based on Spencer's description, I figured we should dress for a funeral that he didn't know he was throwing.
I don't want anyone to pop out of it.
Is there anything I can do to help?
I need this party to be fun.
I have access to a lot of animal drugs.
I should have planned this party myself.
I was too focused on iCarly.
I mean, Carly's your girlfriend, so...
Oh, no, no, Carly's not my girlfriend.
Buddy, you gotta pick up the pace.
This party looks like a home run to me!
Coming to you live from my loves launch party.
The Kevin app is the cutting edge of animal therapy.
I downloaded it ten minutes ago, and now I don't feel bad about my passive role in climate change.
Look, I had my grandmother's ring size for Carly, just in case.
How'd you know Carly's ring size?
Are you accusing me of breaking in last night while Carly was asleep, measuring her finger?
Then singing a few bars of landslide just to ensure pleasant dreams?
Now where's the hubby to be?
Your mom did something very sweet and expensive and a dot illegal.
I should have warned you, that kind of sexual charisma cannot be contained.
I know what you have to do.
No, I can't let you take the fall for this.
This is the answer to your problem.
